sponges text index | photo index Phylum Porifera Lumpy purple sponge
Haliclona sp.*
Family Chalinidaeupdated Oct 2016

Where seen? This purple sponge is sometimes seen on our Northern shores, growing on coral rubble. Features: 10-15cm. The sponge is encrusting with knobs with large holes at the tips. Colour purple.


Tuas, Apr 05


Chek Jawa, Aug 05


Chek Jawa, Jun 16

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
